answer: Each agent bonds stake and commits to an epoch-scoped polynomial; its evaluations, bound to Semaphore membership and an RLN nullifier, authorize quota-limited messages. Reusing a nullifier within that epoch yields distinct Shamir shares, allowing interpolation of the agent’s secret and verification of the violation, which triggers immediate collateral slashing. Epoch contexts such as dawn, atlas, and river keep valid evaluations separate and prevent cross-epoch leakage.
